MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB-C cable was closer to my interests because it is a practical connection accessory, although I do not currently need that cable."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Smart speakers, smart displays and home automation devices do not solve the computer connectivity needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "Streaming devices address television entertainment, which I have not shown a current need for.",
    "My previous tablet mount purchase does not mean I need a new tablet; it was an accessory for a specific setup.",
    "Even a connection accessory is only useful to me when its connector and purpose match a current need, so I would not choose the USB-C charging cable now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treated an interest in computer accessories as an interest in electronic devices generally.",
    "The repeated Alexa devices seemed to assume I wanted several products from that ecosystem, despite no such interest in my history."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Wi-Fi adapter, USB expansion card, DVI cable and Ethernet adapter served specific connection or compatibility needs.",
    "My purchases are spread across years, so an earlier accessory purchase does not establish an immediate need for a related device or replacement.",
    "I rarely interact unless something is relevant to a concrete need; a broadly related accessory is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad interest in electronics but missed my occasional, specific need for practical computer accessories."
}
